# Bayfield Heating & Cooling

> Bayfield Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Bayfield, Huron County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 565-0204  |  Email: contact@bayfieldheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://bayfieldheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Bayfield, Goderich, Clinton, Vanastra, Hensall
